title: A building guide per problem kind: only cited sentences kept, too few builds said
request: A guide per model type from what is known.
plan: Claims from accepted items and the catalog.
cited.check keeps only cited sentences whose numbers are in their sources.

decisions.decision: A kind with too few builds says so instead of a typical number.

findings.defect: The guide lost its citation marks.
findings.scenario: An accepted item's sentence appeared without [ID].
findings.cause: cited.check returns the sentence with its marks stripped and the cites apart.
findings.fix: Put the marks back from the kept sentence's cites.

outcome: Guides cite what they rest on.
lessons: Read what a checker returns before relying on it.
